note: Damage register, press/agency-derived inside 72 hours. Per docs/DAMAGE.md: figures are never summed into totals while unverified; source class is recorded but promotion to verified is custodian-signed only (issue #2).

authoritative_mapping.value: Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping activation EMSR927 (four areas of interest)

categories.value: flash floods along ~72 km of the Trishuli; Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts; origin in the Lhende basin with an ice-rock avalanche descending ~1,200 m
categories.source: Wikipedia (2026 Nepal floods) / ICIMOD press release

categories.value: more than 240 destroyed, 32 damaged — within CEMS-mapped areas of interest only
categories.note: EO-derived within mapped AOIs; NOT an event total.

categories.value: ~42 km damaged; the Betrawati-Rasuwagadhi road reported destroyed; the Syafrubesi-Rasuwagadhi road, under reconstruction after the 2025 flood, damaged again
categories.note: The 2025-damage-repeated detail matters: this corridor floods repeatedly.

categories.value: 14 projects, ~748 MW combined (9 operating totalling 354 MW; 5 under construction totalling 394 MW); ~430 MW of supply affected, roughly one-eighth of national installed capacity
categories.source_class: official agency via press (Nepal Electricity Authority)

categories.metric: preliminary cost estimate, roads and bridges
categories.note: Preliminary government figure; expect large revision.
